curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.strand: Language use 2.3.1 Verbs ‘to do’- Present form
curriculum.outcomeText: pick out the words verbs ‘to do’ (do, does) and subjective pronouns (I, she/he, it) from an oral text

interactions.prompt: Listen: I do my work. Which word names the speaker?
interactions.feedback: Yes! I names the person who is speaking.
interactions.retryHint: Say the sentence again and listen for the word before do.

interactions.prompt: Tap the doing helper in: She does her work.
interactions.feedback: Great! Does is the helper used with she.
interactions.retryHint: Find the word between She and her.

interactions.prompt: Match each pronoun to the words heard with it.
interactions.feedback: Well matched! I goes with do; he and it go with does.
interactions.retryHint: Try each pair aloud: I do, he does, it does.

interactions.prompt: Listen: He does the sweeping. Pick the pronoun and the do-word.
interactions.feedback: Correct! He is the pronoun and does is the do-word.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the word naming a boy and the helper that follows it.

interactions.prompt: Sort the words you hear into pronouns and do-words.
interactions.feedback: Excellent sorting! Pronouns name who or what; do and does are do-words.
interactions.retryHint: First find I, she, and it. The two words left are do-words.

interactions.prompt: Complete what you heard: It ___ make a sound.
interactions.feedback: Super! It does is the matching pair.
interactions.retryHint: Say both choices aloud: It do; It does. Choose the one that sounds right.
